zones.name: Trishuli River Lower Basin (Bahrabise Sector)
zones.description: Glacial surge and flash flood inundation. Main highway bridge destroyed, residential quarter flooded under 4.8m debris water.
zones.cannot_ignore_reason: PROTOCOL 15-DAY LOCK: Inundated on Oct 6. Safety protocol prohibits closing, ignoring, or demoting flooded zone reports for at least 15 days (Active until Oct 21).

zones.name: Bhote Koshi Torrential Gorge (Tatopani Confluence)
zones.description: Massive mudflow and glacial lake breach along narrow river gorge. Heavy debris deposition, border crossing submerged.
zones.cannot_ignore_reason: PROTOCOL 15-DAY LOCK: Inundated on Oct 8. Mandatory post-flood monitoring active until Oct 23. Report dismissal strictly blocked.

zones.name: Dhunche South Slope & Valley Flank
zones.description: River embankment breached by 2.1m crest. Lateral landslides destabilizing the secondary arterial road.

zones.name: Syabrubesi Foothill & Buffer Perimeter
zones.description: Rising waters in upstream tributaries. Water level within 40cm of top of retaining wall. Precautionary evacuation advisory issued.

zones.name: Dhunche District Hospital & Military Relief Camp
zones.description: Safe highland evacuation camp (elevation 2,050m MSL). Equipped with medical helipad, 400 hospital beds, clean drinking water supply.

zones.name: Bidur High Plateau Disaster Support Depot
zones.description: Central disaster coordination hub outside the flood inundation vector. Heliport and satellite comms online.

zones.name: Hindmata & Dadar TT Waterlogged Basin (Mumbai Monsoon)
zones.description: Chronic monsoon saucer depression. Dr. Ambedkar Road submerged. BMC dewatering pumps operating at 100% capacity.
zones.cannot_ignore_reason: MANDATORY 15-DAY LOCK: Post-monsoon flooding watch active until Oct 24.

zones.name: Milan Subway & Western Express Flank (Santacruz)
zones.description: Underpass inundated up to railway roof beam level. All vehicular traffic diverted to SV Road flyover.
zones.cannot_ignore_reason: MANDATORY 15-DAY LOCK: Monsoon flood alert locked until Oct 25.

zones.name: Kurla Kamani & Mithi River Swell Corridor
zones.description: High tide at 4.6m coinciding with 120mm/hr cloudburst. River levee erosion along LBS Marg.

zones.name: Gandhi Market & King Circle Low Perimeter
zones.description: Water accumulation near railway culverts. Slow traffic moving on central lane only.

zones.name: Malabar Hill & Cumballa Ridge Safe Haven
zones.description: High-altitude natural basalt ridge. Emergency government relief shelter and medical supplies center.

flood_prone_areas.name: Bhotekoshi Alluvial Meander Choke-Point
flood_prone_areas.notes: Natural constriction in canyon creates 6-meter backwater surge whenever sediment volume exceeds 200 m³/s.

flood_prone_areas.name: Langtang Khola Confluence Silt Flat
flood_prone_areas.notes: Unconsolidated moraine deposits upstream subject to sudden damming and breach.
